details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4797-4819 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: dispatch_validation_if_needed allows validation dispatch when PROJECT_COMPLETE is unset.
  WHY: The belt-and-suspenders gate only blocks explicit non-"true" values, so an early or mis-scoped invocation can dispatch validation against an incomplete project state.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10089-10119 | severity=medium | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The completion-status text can show "ready" while validation recovery is still in flight if PROJECT_STATUS is not "in_progress" despite validation_recovery_count > 0.
  WHY: An inconsistent or manually edited state file can produce a misleading operator-facing status during recovery.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10001-10120 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The completion-status path reparses the same WAVE_STATUS JSON blob with multiple jq invocations.
  WHY: Each extraction respawns jq and reprocesses the full blob, adding avoidable overhead on the hot poll path.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1385-1390 | severity=medium | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The state-hash shortcut returns early without re-verifying the live GitHub comment.
  WHY: If the cached comment was deleted or recreated, the state file can keep a stale completion_status_comment_id until a later successful COMMENTS fetch.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1408-1422 | severity=medium | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: Switching to gh api -f body=... changes comment-body serialization in a way that can drift from the raw body used for hashing.
  WHY: Any encoding or line-ending normalization mismatch will prevent the idempotency hash from matching, forcing repeated PATCH/POST cycles.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8825-8827 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Resetting PROJECT_COMPLETE, WAVE_COMPLETE, and ANY_FAILED only after each issue can leak prior issue state into the next issue.
  WHY: Stale per-issue scratch state can corrupt later completion or validation-dispatch decisions in the same shell.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1290-1318 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: State-file updates for completion-status metadata are not protected by locking or retry protection.
  WHY: Concurrent poll runs can interleave read-modify-write cycles and lose comment-id, body-hash, or alert-sent updates.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1307-1343 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Invalid status tokens are only rejected after the helper has already built completion-status body/hash state.
  WHY: The helper can do unnecessary work before rejecting bad input, and the validation ordering leaves room for side effects before the guard trips.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1364 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: completion_status_comment_body_hash is accepted without validating that it is a 64-character lowercase hex digest.
  WHY: An unvalidated hash can make the persisted state inconsistent and break the idempotency shortcut.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1327-1427 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: Empty or malformed GitHub comment API responses can leave completion-status metadata unpersisted or make a failed update look successful.
  WHY: When the response lacks a usable numeric id, the helper can return failure after the comment was already written, or succeed without persisting the new id/body-hash state.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4933-4950 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The validation-recovery branch returns before calling update_completion_status_comment.
  WHY: The completion-status comment stays stale during recovery and only corrects on a later poll tick.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:4901-4957 / 10089-10189 / 10172 / 12247 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: update_completion_status_comment failures are swallowed and the COMPLETION_STATUS_STATE_CHANGED flush path depends on success-only side effects.
  WHY: Transient API or persist failures can prevent comment metadata and completion-status alert flags from being flushed, which leads to stale pinned state, duplicate comments, or repeated alerts.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10093-10115 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Skipped wave issues are omitted from both the pending and failed completion-status lists.
  WHY: Operators lose visibility into deliberately skipped work even though it affects why a wave is not fully complete.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1290-1318 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: No file locking or atomic retry protects the state-file read-modify-write path for completion-status metadata.
  WHY: Overlapping pollers can lose updates and leave the comment-id/hash/alert state inconsistent.
- agents.md:129-174 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The docs call these "pinned-comment families" even though the implementation edits comments in place and does not use GitHub's pin API.
  WHY: Operators can misread the contract and expect pinning behavior that the code does not implement.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Defensive dispatch gate inside dispatch_validation_if_needed: skip the validate dispatch this cycle when PROJECT_COMPLETE != \"true\"."
  expected_change_site: dispatch_validation_if_needed (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: The implemented preflight only blocks when PROJECT_COMPLETE is explicitly set and not "true"; an unset PROJECT_COMPLETE still falls through and dispatches validation.
- requirement: Persist `.completion_status_comment_id` + `.completion_status_comment_body_hash` in the state file so edit-in-place fallback survives the next cron invocation, and confirm the once-per-project alert fires exactly once and does not re-fire.
  expected_change_site: all four update_completion_status_comment call sites plus the end-of-loop post_state_comment guard and the completion-status alert-flag block
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: Every call site resets COMPLETION_STATUS_STATE_CHANGED to false before invoking the helper, the helper only flips it after a successful persist, and the flush path only runs when the flag is true; failures can therefore skip persisting metadata and the alert-sent marker.
- requirement: "bash -n scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh — syntax valid." + "CI: lint / existing pytest suite green."
  expected_change_site: tests directory
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: No new test files or cases reference update_completion_status_comment or persist_completion_status_comment_state, and the completion-status comment flow is not exercised end-to-end.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
